text:
lee: Heads-up: I noticed several anchor links broken on the migration preview (some old mkdocs anchors not matching docusaurus ids).

maria: Which pages?

lee: Mostly under /reference/sdk and a couple in /guides. Links like `#kv_cache` now point to `#kv-cache-1` or get lost entirely.

jonathan: That sounds like the slugifier differences. MkDocs used underscores for some headings (e.g. `KV Cache`) and our docusaurus slugger uses hyphens; duplicates end up with -1 suffixes.

lee: CI output: 
```
ERROR: unresolved link 'reference/sdk.md#kv_cache' referenced from 'guides/caching.md'
INFO: generated id 'kv-cache' and duplicate id 'kv-cache-1' in reference/sdk.md
```

sasha: Quick fix options: normalize all headings to ascii, prefer hyphens, and update internal links. Or make our slugger behavior compatible with mkdocs by converting underscores to hyphens during build.

maria: I prefer normalizing headings in the source so authors are explicit. Tools can help but human readable is better.

jonathan: Agreed. I'll add a lint step that flags headings that contain underscores or other unexpected punctuation. We can use remark-lint with a custom rule.

lee: I sketched a small script: `scripts/fix-headings.js` which replaces multiple whitespace/underscore runs with a single hyphen and reports changed files.

sasha: Opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/880 — includes the script, tests, and a docs/contributing note about heading conventions.

docbot: build-preview: failed on commit 4a7b2c0 — see https://ci.internal.redwood/dev/docs/3489

maria: Can CI also run a slug-compare that builds the site and then walks the generated html to find mismatches between hrefs and ids?

jonathan: Yes. I'll add `node ./tools/compare-slugs.js` to the preview pipeline. It will emit a compact report and fail the job if any mismatch found.

lee: FYI the weirdest cases come from copy/paste from Google Docs where en-dash or non-breaking spaces sneak in. The script normalizes NFKC and replaces en/em dashes with ascii hyphen.

sasha: Also added a one-time migration commit that touches ~12 files to apply fixes (prefixed with MIGRATE-ANCHOR). Small PR so reviewers can eyeball changes.

maria: Good. After PR merges, we should run a global link checker and then a docs-preview to verify. Can we get a preview URL when it's ready?

docbot: preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.dev/?pr=880 (renders reference/sdk and guides/caching)

lee: Verified locally and on preview. All anchors resolved. Quick sanity-check: `grep -R "#kv-cache" -n docs | wc -l` shows updated links.

jonathan: I'll follow up with a tiny pre-commit hook so authors running `git commit` will get a warning if headings contain unexpected punctuation. Using husky + a fast node script.

maria: Also add a blurb in the changelog under docs: "Normalized heading punctuation to prevent broken internal anchors after Docusaurus migration."

sasha: PR merged. Leaving a note for maintainers in the docs team channel about the new lint rule and the pre-commit hook.

lee: Thanks everyone. Locking this thread. If anything else pops, reopen with the preview link. :thumbsup:
